purpose: Define elective pacing, workload, classification, promotion, and planned families without creating false course authority.

academicYear.note: The flexible completion window preserves time for demanding core courses, interruptions, recovery, and learner-paced completion without lowering mastery expectations.

electives.rotationPurpose: Allow meaningful exploration without turning every elective into another full-year academic burden.
electives.simultaneousEnrollmentRule: Electives count toward the maximum active class load of eight during the regular academic year.

summer.policy: Learners may take as many electives as they choose over summer, subject to course prerequisites, safety requirements, and reasonable learner-selected workload.

plannedFamilies.title: Critical Thinking
plannedFamilies.intent: Claims, evidence, logic, source credibility, statistical reasoning, media literacy, competing explanations, and evidence-based defense.

plannedFamilies.title: Writing Studio
plannedFamilies.intent: Creative, journalistic, rhetorical, technical, and publishing-centered writing pathways with drafting and revision evidence.

plannedFamilies.title: Life Skills
plannedFamilies.intent: Practical independence, communication, organization, household management, decision-making, basic finance, safety, and planning.

plannedFamilies.title: Trades
plannedFamilies.intent: Applied skilled-trade exploration using safety-first projects, construction math, tools, repair, mechanical literacy, and discipline-specific competency evidence.

guardrails: Electives should add curiosity and capability without creating unnecessary academic congestion.
Discipline-authentic evidence is preferred over cloning one assessment model across every elective.
Compact duration does not lower academic quality, mastery, safety, privacy, or evidence standards.
Planned families do not become learner-selectable until their production and promotion gates pass.
Required Academy courses may use compact architecture without being classified as elective choice.
